items.raw_excerpt: Given the high price of alcohol in Norway, a hangover is something of a luxury problem.
items.summary_en: In Norway, alcohol prices are very high. So getting a hangover costs a lot of money. This makes a hangover feel like a luxury problem.
items.summary_ko: 노르웨이는 술값이 매우 비싸서 숙취도 돈이 많이 듭니다. 그래서 이곳에서 숙취는 일종의 사치스러운 고민이 됩니다. 이 단어는 그런 상황을 재미있게 담아낸 표현입니다.
items.title_en: A word for the day after drinking too much
items.title_ko: 과음한 다음 날을 뜻하는 노르웨이 단어
items.title_original: Norwegian word of the day: Fyllesyke

items.raw_excerpt: For more than half a century, this Ford manufacturing plant was known as the home of the iconic Falcon. Now there is a proposal to turn it into a giant data centre and locals are worried.
items.summary_en: For over fifty years, this factory made the famous Ford Falcon car. There is now a plan to turn it into a huge data centre. Local people are worried about losing a piece of their history.
items.summary_ko: 50년 넘게 이 공장은 유명한 포드 팰컨 자동차를 만들었습니다. 이제 이 공장을 거대한 데이터센터로 바꾸려는 계획이 나왔습니다. 지역 주민들은 역사의 일부를 잃게 될까 걱정하고 있습니다.
items.title_en: Old Ford Falcon factory may become a huge data centre. Locals are worried.
items.title_ko: 포드 팰컨 공장이 데이터센터로 바뀔 예정, 주민들은 우려
items.title_original: Ford's factory 'helped make Australia'. Can a data centre have the same legacy?

items.raw_excerpt: An historic pub in the small West Yorkshire village of Old Snydale is set for a £270,000 refurbishment from Heineken-owned Star Pubs.
items.summary_en: The Cross Keys is the only pub in Old Snydale, a small village in West Yorkshire, England. It is a historic pub, and Star Pubs, owned by Heineken, plans a £270,000 refurbishment. A supporter said it felt like the stars had aligned.
items.summary_ko: 크로스 키스는 웨스트요크셔의 작은 마을 올드스나이들에 있는 유일한 펍입니다. 하이네켄이 소유한 스타 펍스가 이 역사적인 펍을 27만 파운드를 들여 리모델링할 계획입니다. 한 관계자는 이번 일이 하늘이 웃어준 듯한 우연이 겹친 일이라고 느껴졌다고 말했습니다.
items.title_en: The only pub in a small Yorkshire village is getting a big makeover
items.title_ko: 작은 요크셔 마을의 유일한 펍, 27만 파운드 대대적 리모델링 예정
items.title_original: ‘It felt like the stars had aligned’: Only pub in small Yorkshire village set for major £270,000 refurb - Yorkshire Post

items.raw_excerpt: Widespread drought and record-breaking heatwaves have forced France to relax some of its famously strict rules on cheese production, with authorities announcing on Wednesday special measures for abondance, beaufort and comté.
items.summary_en: Widespread drought and record heatwaves are forcing France to relax some of its famously strict rules on cheese production. Authorities announced special measures for abondance, beaufort and comté cheeses.
items.summary_ko: 광범위한 가뭄과 기록적인 폭염으로 프랑스가 유명하게 엄격한 치즈 생산 규정 일부를 완화한다. 당국은 아봉당스, 보포르, 콩테 치즈에 대한 특별 조치를 발표했다.
items.title_en: France relaxes cheese-making rules because of heatwaves and drought
items.title_ko: 프랑스, 폭염과 가뭄으로 치즈 생산 규정 완화
items.title_original: France to relax cheese-making rules due to record heatwaves and drought

items.raw_excerpt: Portugal is small enough to drive across in a day, and far too rich to understand that way. There is a Portugal you see from a car window. And then there is the Portugal you discover one quiet road at a time.
items.summary_en: Portugal is small enough to drive across in one day. But it is too rich and varied to understand that way. There is a Portugal you see from a car window, and another Portugal you find by driving one quiet road at a time.
items.summary_ko: 포르투갈은 하루 만에 차로 건널 수 있을 만큼 작은 나라입니다. 하지만 그렇게 빨리 지나가면 이 나라를 제대로 이해하기 어렵습니다. 차창 밖으로만 보는 포르투갈이 있고, 조용한 길을 하나씩 찾아다닐 때 만나는 또 다른 포르투갈이 있습니다.

items.raw_excerpt: Parents say they were unaware that the Charnwood centre was ordered to close for three months from next Thursday.
items.summary_en: A childcare centre in Canberra has been ordered to stop operating for three months starting next Thursday. The provider is entering administration. Parents say they did not know about the closure until now.
items.summary_ko: 캔버라의 한 어린이집이 다음 주 목요일부터 3개월간 운영을 중단하라는 명령을 받았다. 운영사가 법정관리에 들어가기 때문이다. 학부모들은 이 사실을 사전에 알지 못했다고 말한다.
items.title_en: Childcare centre told to close for 3 months, parents surprised
items.title_ko: 캔버라 어린이집 3개월 운영 중단 명령, 학부모들은 사전에 몰랐다
items.title_original: Canberra childcare centre ordered to close as provider enters administration
